title: A header paragraph under an auto line multiple below 1 keeps its glyphs whole: the line box shrinks to the multiple (0.058 x 9.76 = 0.57 pt advance), the baseline sits at the ascent share of the shrunken line and the ink overhangs the strip top; the body top is not pushed
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-11-02), pymupdf rawdict span bboxes and baselines, Letter, 1440 margins, header 720 (strip top 36), Calibri 11 docDefaults after 0 line 240, one nextPage section per header part, right-aligned Calibri 8 text under a sz 1 mark: line 14 baseline 36.48 (ink box 28.94-38.61, above the strip top), line 120 baseline 39.84, line 240 baseline 43.68 (= 36 + 0.952 x 8), so the baseline is top + m x ascent; two br-lines at line 14 advance 0.48 (36.48 / 36.96), two paragraphs at line 14 the same; body top 72.05 on every page. gen before the fix: the strip's overflow:hidden cut the glyph at the strip top (ink 36.0-38.0 of a 32.8-39.3 glyph)

cases.note: line 14 (0.058): the whole glyph box lies inside the strip's clip box
two br-lines at line 14 overprint, both unclipped
a squeezed header never pushes the body (same body top as the line 240 control page)
line 240 control: glyph box top at the strip top (gen Carlito box 36.75)
